Phil Mulford's 'Thunderthumbs'

Monday 9th November 2026 - 8:00 pm

Music Charge: £20.00

Book Now

Join us to celebrate great Soul and Funk songs with “Thunderthumbs”, the 10-piece band led by bassist Phil Mulford and inspired by the great US bassist Louis Johnson and the iconic producer Quincy Jones (Michael Jackson). The gig features three brilliant singers, Jacqui Hicks & Debby Bracknell (Shakatak) & Simon Foster (Flying Pickets), a deeply grooving rhythm section and powerhouse horns! Tonight the band will be performing songs from 3 extraordinary albums, all produced by Quincy: "The Dude", "Off the Wall", (Michael Jackson) and "Give Me The Night" (George Benson). Epic! 

"Jacqui Hicks is…one of the most soulful singers in Britain” MU Magazine; “Take Stevie Wonder, Joe Cocker, that dude from The Commitments…roll them up into one and you get something resembling the virtuosity that Simon Foster shows” RARB.org

 

Artist Notification Get notified when Phil Mulford's 'Thunderthumbs' plays at the club.
